Palo Alto PAN-OS.notes: Published post-quantum VPN/IPSec roadmap; hybrid key exchange in progress.

Fortinet FortiOS.notes: Published PQC strategy for FortiGate/FortiVPN lines.

Cisco Firepower / AnyConnect.notes: Cisco has published a post-quantum cryptography strategy across security product lines.

Check Point.notes: PQC evaluation in progress; no committed roadmap date published.

Microsoft ADCS / Windows Server CA.notes: Windows/Schannel has experimental hybrid post-quantum TLS group support.

AWS KMS.notes: AWS supports hybrid post-quantum key exchange (ML-KEM) in select services (S3, KMS, ACM).

Azure Key Vault.notes: Hybrid PQC TLS piloted in some Azure services; not yet default.

Google Cloud KMS.notes: Google has been an early driver of ML-KEM hybrid TLS (Chrome, BoringSSL, Cloud services).

Oracle TDE.notes: No native PQC support in Oracle TDE as of current releases; relies on underlying OS/TLS stack.

MS SQL Server TDE.notes: No native PQC algorithm support yet; depends on OS-level TLS stack for transport.

PostgreSQL.notes: PQC support depends entirely on the linked OpenSSL version/build for TLS; no native DB-layer PQC.

MongoDB.notes: No native PQC support; TLS layer PQC readiness depends on the deployed OpenSSL version.

MySQL.notes: No native PQC support; depends on linked TLS library version.

Entrust PKI.notes: Entrust offers PQC-ready certificate issuance and crypto-agility tooling.

DigiCert CertCentral.notes: DigiCert offers PQC certificate trials and crypto-agility platform support.

Venafi.notes: Crypto-agility platform actively adding PQC certificate lifecycle support.

Thales Luna HSM.notes: Luna HSMs support NIST-selected PQC algorithms (ML-KEM/ML-DSA) in recent firmware.

SafeNet HSM.notes: PQC algorithm support being rolled out across the SafeNet/Luna HSM line.

F5 BIG-IP.notes: F5 has added hybrid post-quantum TLS group support in recent BIG-IP versions.

Citrix ADC.notes: PQC evaluation in progress; no committed public roadmap date.

NGINX.notes: PQC support depends entirely on the linked OpenSSL/BoringSSL build; not default in most deployments.

VMware.notes: PQC evaluation in progress across virtualization/NSX product lines.

IBM (Cloud / LinuxONE).notes: IBM has strong PQC/quantum-safe crypto offerings across LinuxONE and IBM Cloud HSM/KMS.
